done_rule: Done requires a formally exhaustive, machine-checkable closure surface with no remaining parser rejection debt and no remaining coverage/gap debt for the family claim.
required_surface_missing_detail: SystemVerilog requires its checked-in external-corpus-backed proof-surface sidecar (expected_proof_surface_sidecar) to match the live triage gate output exactly — same case set, same per-case status, same totals — for the formal-exhaustive-closure surface to be considered green.
